--- run-ollama.sh ---
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
BASE='/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp'
export HOME="$BASE"
export PATH="$BASE/envs/open-terminal/bin:$BASE/miniconda/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
export LANG=C
export LC_ALL=C
umask 077
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$BASE/ollama-runtime.env"
exec "$BASE/miniconda/bin/ollama" serve

--- keepalive state names ---
ensure.lock
